items.finding: Section 3.2 says to make results look good but gives no reproducible pass/fail check against the service's relevance contract, so a relevance regression could be accepted on judgment alone.
Section 3.4 requires synonym-bundle-2025-02 without naming a producing step or available source, so the load cannot be completed from the plan's earlier outputs.
Section 3.3 creates catalog_search_v3 instead of the reserved hyphenated physical name, so the index created by this step does not match the plan's approved naming facts.
Section 3.5 compares catalog-search-2025-03 even though Section 3.3 creates catalog_search_v3, so the comparison can target an index that this run never loaded.
Section 3.6 assigns the rehearsal to Priya Nair during her March 3–7 leave, leaving a required owner unavailable in the proposed window.
Section 3.7 switches all traffic but its way back only says the team will decide after observation, so it provides no executable rollback if the live change harms customers.
Section 4.1 lists artifacts and an announcement but never defines the checks or sign-off that establish the entire migration is complete.
